pr_title: Fix #38904 - XMLParser/_parse_comment - detect the end of comment
pr_comments:
Won't this break on nested comments, which the previous code explicitly aimed to handle with `count`?

Like `<!-- This is the comment syntax: <!-- Comment -->, easy, no? -->`.

That being said the specification seems to prohibit nested comments, so I guess it's fine: https://www.w3.org/TR/2008/REC-xml-20081126/#sec-comments

Remark: Sometime, godot doesn't crash.

**Steps to reproduce:**

See below to create comment example and gdscript code.
Launch the code on gdscript (function load_xml)

**Minimal reproduction project:**

* Create file assets/comment.xml
```
<myxml>
<!-- X uint32 << 32 | Y uint32 -->
</myxml>
```

* Create GDscript with this function
```
func load_xml():
	var _database_xml = XMLParser.new()
	_database_xml.open("res://assets/comment.xml")
	_database_xml.seek(0)
	var ret = OK
	while ret == OK:
		ret = _database_xml.read()
```


**Patch possible to solve this issue**
```
--- a/core/io/xml_parser.cpp
+++ b/core/io/xml_parser.cpp
@@ -196,16 +196,20 @@ void XMLParser::_parse_comment() {
 
        char *pCommentBegin = P;
 
-       int count = 1;
+       ERR_FAIL_COND_MSG(*P != '-', "Bad XML comment");
+       ++P;
+       ERR_FAIL_COND_MSG(*P != '-', "Bad XML comment");
+       ++P;
 
        // move until end of comment reached
-       while (count) {
-               if (*P == '>')
-                       --count;
-               else if (*P == '<')
-                       ++count;
-
+       for (;;) {
+               while (*P != '-')
+                       ++P;
+               if (*P != '-')
+                       continue;
                ++P;
+               if (*P == '>')
+                       break;
        }
 
        P -= 3;
```

review_comments:
This would allow closing a comment with `--->`, which is not well-formed according to the spec:

> Note that the grammar does not allow a comment ending in `--->`. 

https://www.w3.org/TR/2008/REC-xml-20081126/#sec-comments

Very good remark, I will update my patch to include your remark.
 * detect EOF
 * correct to use the correct syntax (to ignore end comment like ---> )
   Comment	   ::=   	'<!--' ((Char - '-') | ('-' (Char - '-')))* '-->'
* For break on nested comments, is not valid XML
   what do you want? 
   (keep this functionality, adding option to disable/enable this functionality - and by default enable nested comments)
Do we get an infinite loop if the comment is not closed?
Yes, like the last code, If I understand, the code break automaticall, but If you want I can check.
